registered_addition_groups.rationale: The encode site computes canonical SHA-256 material for immutable authorization/rollback verification. record.pop removes only the supplied rollback_digest from a fresh local copy before independently recomputing it. These sites do not mutate legacy runtime/domain authority, do not open M3-E, and do not perform persistence I/O.

The sys.path bootstrap and filesystem writes are confined to an explicit operator command. The command writes only a permission-restricted private rollback control outside the repository, never runs automatically, preserves legacy persistence paths and per-domain authority, leaves M3-E closed, and fails closed on conflicting overwrite.
The subscript assignment deliberately tampers a local test-only rollback mapping to prove digest/scope verification fails closed. It has no production mutation or persistence path.
